reviews.text: Cheesecake always comes home looking very handsome and smelling wonderful! You can’t see his snazzy bandanna in pretty fall colors! Woof Gang always does a great job.
Just moved to the area from LA, where our dog had the same groomer for 10 years. SO happy to have found Robbie at Woof Gang. Robbie did an amazing job and our pup looks great!

Our 50lb dog was in desperate need of a bath & de-shedding. He went in with fur tufts sticking out and a little nervous and came back out looking like a shiny new dog, happy, & relaxed! Loved his spa day! Thank you so much, we will be back!!
Quickest and easiest nail trimming experience! And Oreo definitely appreciates the treat options afterward.
Amazing  great place for a quick  cut and wash 5 stars.  Friendly staff with so many options of treats for the dogs or cats. Best place in park slope
Thank you for your positive rating! Your support empowers us, and we look forward to the opportunity to serve you again.

Lincoln is not an easy customer & he hates to be groomed. Maria did another amazing job with him. He emerged from the spa room looking great & ready for fall. The Woolf Gang staff is kind, professional, & upfront about costs. The store is clean, organized & functions as a dog bakery. So if you have a foodie for a dog, aka Lincoln, be warned. We barely made it out without Lincoln snagging a birthday cake! Thanks again. You guys are great.

Absolutely lovely!!! Wonderful people and took great care of my pup during each bath/groom! My dog always wants to go in, and the staff couldn’t be nicer! If you’re looking for a puppy cut in Park Slope, look no further! Highly recommend.

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're pleased to hear that you had a positive experience with us. We take pride in our commitment to accountability and appreciate your feedback as it helps us continue to improve.

I just used Woof Gang for the first time to groom my 16 lb terrier mix. They did a great job and the price was much more reasonable than the place I've taking her! I will definitely be using them again.

We love Cam! Best groomer hands down, we followed her from her previous salon even though this one is much further from us. We have a 140# dog, he’s not easy to work with but she’s always great with him. He loves Cam and trusts her and so do we!
Wonderful, thoughtful service.

The Woof Gang team did an exceptional job at communicating before/ after the appointment and at taking good care of my fur baby, a 60lb strong lab mix. Teddy did a wonderful job working with our boy who can be nervous with baths and nail cutting. We’ll definitely be back.
Very compassionate and understanding staff
Great place, I trusted them with my puppy and they took well care of him,
Thank you for your positive feedback! We're thrilled to hear you had a wonderful experience with us and appreciate your support as we strive to make the most of every opportunity.

Cut my dog quite badly and tried to hide it from us. Was a loyal customer but will never return. If cuts happen (which they should never) it is the responsibility of the groomer to tell the owners.

Update: veterinarian confirmed result of clipper burn. Don’t appreciate them listing my dogs name and information below. Unprofessional.

Will never come back to this groomer again. When picking up our dog they gave her back with two spots where they had shaved down to her skin, and cut (as in wounded) her. I initially did not see these until i got home.

They did not mention any issues, injuries or anything when I asked how it went. This is unacceptable, its one thing if an accident happens (dogs can squirm, etc..) but to try and cover it up and not say anything is awful and shady.

after the fact they tried to blame it on her harness, even though we had been to the vet two days prior and no cuts or injuries were identified when she was at the vet. Also see picture of her with her harness on an you can see that is not possible for this cut. This lack of accountability from the business is appalling and I would never trust them again with my dog, nor would i recommend anyone else do so

They did a great job fixing the haircut I gave my dog. 😅 And managed to clip her nails (she hates that). She looked and smelled great! They also have a ton of fancy dog treats that my dog really enjoys

Poor customer experience. There's no scheduled pickup window -- you're expected to wait all day for a text, then have just 15 minutes to collect your pet before a $15 fee. I missed one message during the workday, got charged, and staff were rude about it. If you charge late-pickup fees, provide a pickup window. Won't be back -- not recommended.
